title: The Cursed Tile Square

steps.prompt: A 4 x 4 floor of tiles is numbered so that every row and every column contains each of 1, 2, 3 and 4 exactly once. Some tiles have crumbled to '?'. Read the numbers of ROW 1 from left to right as a 4-digit code.

reveal_text: One clause is underlined in blood. It contains the number 4.
